text: {"lessons":["My account is still above its Period 1 value, but the recent decline from its Period 6–7 high is a reminder that gains can reverse; I should consider overall risk and not rely on recent performance.","Selling Stock E at a large gain felt rewarding, but I should not let that win—or my reluctance to admit a loss—decide whether to hold or sell; I should reassess each position on its merits.","Past price changes do not predict future ones, and checking often or trading more is not an edge; I should make deliberate decisions and avoid unnecessary trades."]}
